name: A Quick Grocery Run
summary: Skonk asks you to gather ingredients for a dish in Arathi Highlands. He learned to cook after other ogres mocked his size and fighting ability.

sections.title: Skonk's Ingredients
sections.body: Skonk, an ogre in Arathi Highlands, needs ingredients for a dish he knows how to make. Other ogres laughed at his size and called him weak, so he turned to cooking. You gather the ingredients and bring them to him.

faq.answer: Skonk is an ogre who learned to cook after other ogres mocked his size and fighting ability.
Other ogres laughed at Skonk for being smaller and called him weak, so he learned to cook instead of fight.
Skonk needs ingredients for a dish he can make.

faq.q: Where do I bring the ingredients?
faq.answer: Bring the ingredients to Skonk in Arathi Highlands.

angles.text: As a cook, you can help Skonk gather ingredients for a dish he knows how to make.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Quick Grocery Run
